narr: A cold front approached the Mid-South during the afternoon hours on July 1, 2021. Numerous showers and thunderstorms developed across the Mid-South along and ahead of the front. Locally heavy rainfall occurred due to a very moist airmass and slow-moving storms.
ev: The railroad underpass on Riverside Drive near Crump Boulevard and Interstate 55 was flooded.
